findings.description: Backup/restore lacks executed evidence.
findings.evidence: SQLite and PostgreSQL tools, 11 adversarial tests and representative application-readable restore drills pass.

findings.description: Mutable commands required durable compatible replay, uniform incompatible conflicts and Greenlight revocation/fencing.
findings.evidence: Exact published head bc01fa7b54341865f848c0754884cc83f660a0c7 passed GitHub Actions run 29871278876 with all eight jobs successful. Local evidence passed 97/97 PostgreSQL tests including compatible/incompatible cross-replica races and package-once behavior, 97 locked-wheel tests, 35 frontend tests, package, infrastructure, secret and supply-chain gates. Durable digest-only receipts, exact replay, authenticated decision identity, Greenlight revocation and fencing are proven for the current sandbox. External providers still require outbound outbox/idempotency/receipt controls before activation.

findings.description: Selected architecture lacks threat and privacy models.
findings.evidence: Selected-runtime threat model, privacy model and data-classification/retention register exist and the bounded error/denial findings were repaired and tested.

findings.description: No staging/cloud runtime observation.
findings.evidence: No authorized target or apply evidence.

findings.description: Product version drifted between frontend and runtime/chart.
findings.evidence: All npm/Python/API/metrics/OCI/Helm version surfaces are 0.7.0 and validator detects drift.

findings.description: README contains mutually contradictory architecture claims.
findings.evidence: README and implementation audit now match backend transport, PostgreSQL and deployment evidence boundaries.

findings.description: Automated Chromium proves keyboard activation, skip-link focus, 320 CSS px reflow, reduced motion and AX semantics; human screen-reader, rendered contrast, 400% zoom/reflow and visual review remain absent.
findings.evidence: 8ecf77e7f58789d1e5b47826b595b172bac6fa89; npm run verify:accessibility-browser; docs/accessibility/manual-review-protocol.md; automated evidence is explicitly not manual certification.

findings.description: Production backups require scheduling, encrypted immutable off-host retention, KMS/key lifecycle and exercised alert delivery.
findings.evidence: Exact local commit 6a885827b7e89d06111c87c34293250eab196d47 adds private atomic SQLite/PostgreSQL backup freshness metrics, 24-hour RPO/25-hour freshness SLO, stale/missing-signal alerts, deterministic rule exercises and restore-preserving regression. Production scheduler, KMS/encryption, immutable off-host storage, retention and real alert delivery remain external/human-gated.

findings.description: PostgreSQL migration and runtime authority required separation and proof of a non-owner least-privilege runtime role.
findings.evidence: Exact published head 1002d077564618623fe00f27ffae23c2b410aca8 passed GitHub Actions run 29868899218 with all eight jobs successful, including PostgreSQL shared state, locked wheel, container, Helm, Terraform and supply chain. Local exact evidence additionally proved 85/85 under a non-owner role, zero ownership, exact grants, safe search_path, atomic rollback, negative DDL/TEMP/metadata/GRANT/SET ROLE checks, migration/replay and both restores. Persistent environment observation remains tracked by F-004 and SEC-013.

findings.description: No approved retention, deletion, legal-hold or data-subject workflow exists for runs, memories, audit, telemetry and backups.
findings.evidence: Privacy model and classification register explicitly record UNKNOWN jurisdiction and no effective policy or deletion engine.

findings.description: Prompt-injection, groundedness, citation fidelity, harmful-use and legal-overclaim semantic/adversarial evals are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Deterministic unit/integration tests exist, but no complete semantic eval harness or release threshold exists.

findings.description: The audit ledger is transactional but is not hash-chained, signed or exported to immutable storage.
findings.evidence: Database owners/operators can alter rows outside the application interface.

findings.description: A valid principal can amplify denial-audit storage because no general authenticated request quota exists.
findings.evidence: Credential authentication is rate limited; successful principals can repeatedly invoke forbidden actions.

findings.description: Approver and viewer roles had no path to load an existing tenant-scoped run, leaving server-authorized review authority unusable from the production console.
findings.evidence: 4f101221d3ddfb426aded5e7f4caec9c87985b32; ProductionRuntimePanel run lookup and approver contract test prove GET-by-ID without create authority.

findings.description: The previous console rendered generic backend exception detail and collapsed authorization, conflict, rate limit, validation and dependency failures into one message.
findings.evidence: 4f101221d3ddfb426aded5e7f4caec9c87985b32; bounded notice classifier and tests prove non-reflection plus distinct 401/403/404/409/422/429/500/503 states and request correlation.

findings.description: The prior accent-dot selector had no named semantic themes, entitlement state or non-color selected-state contract.
findings.evidence: 8ecf77e7f58789d1e5b47826b595b172bac6fa89; typed catalog, named controls, aria-pressed/live status and contrast tests.

findings.description: A premium theme controlled only by frontend state could be self-granted and survive server revocation.
findings.evidence: f63a58648eec0579d53a007c8ed83ff376b95727; 8ecf77e7f58789d1e5b47826b595b172bac6fa89; exact allowlisted server identity entitlement, session/identity refresh, no persistence, fallback on revocation and tests.

findings.description: The skip link changed the URL fragment but did not transfer focus because main was not programmatically focusable.
findings.evidence: 8ecf77e7f58789d1e5b47826b595b172bac6fa89; main tabIndex=-1 and real Chromium focus-transfer gate.

findings.description: A live SPA could retain premium after the identity configuration removed the entitlement.
findings.evidence: f63a58648eec0579d53a007c8ed83ff376b95727; 8ecf77e7f58789d1e5b47826b595b172bac6fa89; /me synchronization on audit/mutations and immediate free-theme fallback.

findings.description: Initial accessibility browser probes could leave preview/Chromium descendants and fixed ports behind after failure.
findings.evidence: 8ecf77e7f58789d1e5b47826b595b172bac6fa89; dynamic ports, detached process groups, bounded cleanup and post-gate listener check.

findings.description: The Chromium accessibility gate derived a fixed-range CDP port from process PID and accepted any HTTP 200 as Vite readiness, producing nondeterministic exact-head CI and allowing an unrelated server to masquerade as the production bundle.
findings.evidence: Failed run 29876550199 at 6eb2b6b3ee7a253ef67dae64a888198de6594330; repair a3fa52f6c3e0e5e503527f5ba446badf4ee52070 uses system-assigned preview port, Chromium DevToolsActivePort, strict compiled-bundle fingerprint, child exit diagnostics, stale-artifact removal, negative occupied-port proof and three consecutive positive runs.
